rules.title: Rent control for most multifamily units built before 1980
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quote: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes
rules.summary: Most multifamily units built before 1980 are subject to rent control in Berkeley.
rules.coverage_text: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980
rules.exemption_note: New construction (units built after June 1980), single-family homes with tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 1996, most condominiums, certain government-subsidized units, golden duplexes, owner-occupied shared kitchen/bath units, ADUs with owner occupancy (tenancies after Nov 7, 2018), university rentals, and nonprofit cooperatives are exempt from rent control
